senses.gloss: (b. h., √אש , v. אשש) to exist, be strong, happy; v. יָשַׁר.

units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 45:1">Pesik. R. s. 45</cite> <he>התחיל מְאַשְּׁרֵם</he> he commenced by declaring them happy; v. <cite ref="U01961"><he>אַשְׁרֵי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:22">Num. R. s. 14</cite> <he>לאַשֵּׁר את הדין</he> to give strength to the legal decision Y. Gitt. IX, 50ᶜ bot. (<he>אישרניהי</he>) <he>אִישַּׁרְנוּהוּ</he> we have verified it in the presence of &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 15:7">Gen. R. s. 15</cite>, beg. the bux-tree is called <he>תְּאַשּׁוּר</he> because it is <he>מא׳ וכ׳</he> the strongest of all (cmp. <cite ref="A03314"><he>אֵשֶׁל</he></cite>). Y. Succ. III, 54ᵃ top; Y. Meg. I, 72ᵃ top <he>המא׳ שבכלן וכ׳</he> the strongest (expression) of all, is Hallelujah.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 90:6">Gen. R. s. 90</cite>, end (ref. to <he>את כל אֲשֶׁר</he> <cite ref="Genesis 41:56">Gen. XLI, 56</cite>) <he>המְאוּשָּׁרִין שבהם</he> the best stores of all.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 22a:16">Snh. 22ᵃ</cite> is called Ashurith <he>שמְאוּשֶּׁרֶת בכתב</he> because its characters are substantial (Ar. <he>שמאושר</he>); Y. Meg. I, 71ᵇ bot.; Y. Sot. VII, 21ᶜ top.

senses.gloss: to be set up, be erected. Sifra K’dosh. beg. (play on אֲשֵׁרִים) על שם שהם מִתְאַשְּׁרִים מאחרים because they are put up by others.
